## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ead127958a1adff4b27c803e0c70b35bf9c2ef99`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face:** `rules` — the PR's committed file list holds one governed path, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (register row `.claude/**`, Tier S); `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` is unregistered. `hits.rules` = that one path, `hits.schema` empty ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, in seat (the served tier equals the constant's value this session). Under the rule on `main` today the whole diff is read at tier; under the rule this PR lands, the floor is the md and the script is the file its hunks claim about — read in full either way.
- **Accept set and public surface:** no change. No package is touched; `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing. `Clause-②: no`, no arm — right.
- **The rule text (md, +3 lines at L13–15, 44 → 47 of 60):** carries every clause of ruling 6184805932 letter C — item 1 (scope = `reviewFace` `hits` + the files those hunks assert about, cited code read; `Scope:` lists both; widen, ⛔ never below `hits`), item 4 (a rule and the gate that enforces it read as one), item 2 (the remainder = the lane seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT, as a standalone PR, named), item 3 (Tier H approval and the queue guard whole-PR). L11–12 (the tier mapping) are byte-identical; `SKILL.md:186` untouched; no table row added (the width pin 0 holds); no issue number in the operative text.
- **The script:** `reviewScopeHits(paths)` is `reviewFace`'s `hits` de-duplicated, schema first — read off the same function the queue guard decides the face with, never a second classification; empty exactly on the declaration face. `contractReviewRecordLines` prints `Scope:` only at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, right after `Local-runs:`, as plain text (no code span, so the head matcher never sees a path). The record readers are per-key regexes, and the thread-set battery drives the real queue guard with the record that now carries the line and clears on both threads (322 guard cases) — the dispatch's mechanism assumption (b) measured true, no reader and no guard edit. `templateFace` refuses `face` beside `paths` and an empty list; `templateArgsOf` refuses flag-shaped or empty words among the paths. The brief hands the reviewer `--template --paths HITS`, pinned to read back the same face and floor. Battery floor 18 for the new battery; roster floor 10 → 11, both pinned by name.
- **Beyond the ruling's named workload — the `--paths` door** (the CLI arm, `templateFace`, the brief's command, about eight cases). Judged in seat: **KEEP** (the dev's option A). It is the mechanism by which the floor is machine-derived for the seat that writes the record — item 1's own words, 「machine-derived, the same function the queue guard uses」 — and it only prints: no reader, no guard, no public surface. A floor listed by eye is the one way a scope falls below `hits`, which the ruling forbids. Within the letter; an accepted deviation, recorded here, not an escalation.
- **Placeholders and sanitizer:** `PATH-ONE, PATH-TWO` and `CITED-FILE` carry no angle bracket and no path separator; the fence wording moves from a count to 「every placeholder」 because the count now varies by face. The comment citations 「ruling record 6184805932 on #23578」 sit in `scripts/pm/**`, outside the id-lint's walk (87 files clean on the head).

### ② Semver level

No published package in the diff ⇒ no changeset owed; the `skip-changeset` label is the correct declaration and `Check Changeset` reads `skipped` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions[0]` (keep or drop `--paths`): answered in ① — A, keep. Verification and tooling shape under an already-ruled letter; no escalation.
- `deviations`: BASE `7cb33cfef` rather than the dispatch's `c5dd7fce3` — `origin/main` moved before the worktree was cut; the premises were re-read there (the rule line unchanged, `reviewFace` returns `hits: { schema, rules }`, 44 lines) and hold. The 维护者速读 heading spelled with ASCII parentheses — no reader keys on a body heading. The model-free commit trailer pair — correct under AGENTS.md, which outranks the harness reminder.
- `out_of_scope_findings`: none; two acceptance notes (the `usageLines` docblock count, the brief battery's case title) are not debts.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-23578-contract-review-scope`
Reviewed-by: `session_01GjUZrCo7Yi58T4vPXqx88e`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Reviewed 2026-10-15T10:45Z against the PR's committed diff, the card's four records and the head's check-runs (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success at the time of reading; Lint, Type Check and Test Core lanes still converging — the pre-landing gate reading is the seat record's, not this one's).

## 席位核对 — PR #23655 (#23578) @ `ead127958a1adff4b27c803e0c70b35bf9c2ef99` · seat `domain:skills#1` · `session_01GjUZrCo7Yi58T4vPXqx88e` (os-sales) · 2026-10-15T10:53Z

**Verdict: ACCEPT.** Tier S — `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 23655` exit 3: governed, `.claude/**` ×1 (`references/contract-review.md`), `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` not on the register, 208 changed lines (+182/−26) under the 3000 human-merge threshold. The at-tier contract review of record is 6190236120 (PASS on this head, rendered in seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`).

1. **形态:** draft, base `main`, first body line `Fixes #23578` (the card is `pm:dispatched`, assignee os-sales); no other open card number sits near a closing keyword in the body (the other numbers are ruling ids and PR #23389 as precedent); `Clause-②: no` at line start, no arm; `skip-changeset` label; PR assignee os-sales; 2 files, 1 commit; the 维护者速读 draft present with 席位意见 blank (ASCII parentheses in its heading — no reader keys on a body heading); footer in the session-URL form; no model identifier.
2. **前提实测:** on `origin/main` `c5dd7fce3` (the dev's BASE `7cb33cfef` lies between; the premises were re-read there by the dev and here by the seat): `contract-review.md:11–12` still carry 「混合 diff 一处命中即此档」 and the PR leaves them byte-identical; `reviewFace` returns `hits: { schema, rules }` before the PR (`record-recognisers.mjs:170`) and after it (the same function, now also read by `reviewScopeHits`); `SKILL.md:186` is untouched; the file is 47 lines of 60 on the head with no table row (width pin 0 holds).
3. **门禁 check-runs on `ead127958` (read in this act):** required five — `Lint & Repo Gates` success · `TypeScript Type Check` success · `Test Core` success (shards 1–6 success) · `Build Core` skipped · `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. Every other check success, or a skip the expected-skips roster names: `Check Changeset` (success on the gate run, skipped on the labeler run — the `skip-changeset` opt-out), `Check PR Size` and `Auto Label` (one event run each skipped, the other success), `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` (no `needs:pack-smoke` label), `Build Core` (the `core` filter false — a diff outside `packages/**`; its verdict is taken in the queue build), `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrix template, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Console Pin Gate` (full-battery jobs, PR heads skip them), `Build Docs` (the `docs` filter false). The dev's local subset: 37 derived families run at the head, all exit 0, `--ran` reconciled; `record-recognisers --self-test` 184 cases, the queue guard's 322, `post-stamped`'s 679. Instrument note: `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 23655` could not run in this container — `yaml` is declared in the root manifest and absent from the shared checkout's stale `node_modules` (a `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` is running); the roster above was read from the script's source at `c5dd7fce3`, and every skipped name on the head matches an entry and its reason.
4. **接受的偏差:** the `--paths` door beyond the ruling's named workload — kept, judged in 6190236120 (item 1's 「machine-derived, the same function the queue guard uses」; print-only, no reader); the BASE sha; the ASCII-paren heading; the model-free commit trailer pair (AGENTS.md outranks the harness reminder). `mcp_calls` 0; `api_writes` 3 relay strokes, each read back identical.
5. **范围外去向:** `out_of_scope_findings` empty. Two acceptance notes stay on the PR with no carrier owed: the `usageLines` docblock's flag count, the brief battery's case title.
6. **落地条款:** Tier S ⇒ the seat lands through the queue: relay `pr_ready`, then `mergeable_state` read after the flip and `automerge_enable` once it reads `clean` or `blocked`, then `added_to_merge_queue` awaited on the timeline (about six minutes before any re-arm). At MERGED the card closes by `Fixes`, `pm:dispatched` leaves it in the same act, and the landing comment (the two-reading probe table) goes on the card. Pointer line on the card follows this record.
